feed.subtitle: Notes from the bench: what broke, what I measured, and what I changed.

entry.title: A voice assistant that can’t do more than it’s allowed to
entry.summary: How J.A.R.V.I.S. decides what it may touch, why every button goes through the same gate as a spoken request, and the test that once stopped a real printer.

entry.title: Zero support roofs: why a nine-hour print failed
entry.summary: A downloaded print file had 674 support sections and not one roof for the model to land on. Two quick checks would have caught it.

entry.title: Levelling a 420 mm bed by measurement
entry.summary: From 2.965 mm out of true to 0.597 mm, one screw and one probe at a time — and the whole bed usable again.
